exposure: Term neonates born to gestational diabetes mothers
Gestational diabetes status (GDM vs. healthy controls)
cohort: 673 pregnant women who had term pregnancies and were admitted for elective cesarean delivery, with 80 women having gestational diabetes.
finding: Term pregnancies with gestational diabetes had a higher rate of UCB acidosis, which was associated with poor maternal glycemic and weight control during the last gestational trimester.
